summary: Iteration 2 testing of new OFFERS banner + table/party BOOKING features plus regression. Backend: 46 pytest tests (added TestOffers 8 + TestBookings 12) — 46/46 passing after fixing one stale test from iteration_1. Frontend: verified rotating offer banner (3 seeded offers, auto-rotate every 4s, dots switch slides), navbar 'Book Table' scroll, booking form validation (name/mobile/date), COD-style booking submit (BK119) and WhatsApp booking submit (BK120, wa.me tab opened), admin Bookings tab status update (pending->confirmed persisted), admin Offers tab add/toggle/delete with live reflection on homepage banner, and regression of menu/cart/checkout(COD pickup, order CAF1005)/My Orders lookup+reorder and all admin tabs. Mobile (390x844) banner + booking section verified. Zero console errors. All test data cleaned up — DB back to baseline (3 offers, 0 bookings).

minor.issue: No server-side validation of mobile (any string accepted, e.g. '12345') or date (empty string accepted, past dates accepted). Validation exists only in the React form, so direct API calls create junk bookings.

Signature `async def get_offers(all: bool = False, request: Request = None)` uses builtin name `all` and an Optional Request; require_admin(request) would raise AttributeError if request were ever None. Works today but fragile — prefer a separate /api/offers/admin route or Depends.
No DELETE endpoint — admin can only change status; stale/spam bookings can never be removed from the dashboard.

issues: booking-date and booking-time use raw native HTML inputs (type=date/time) showing browser default mm/dd/yyyy picker instead of the shadcn Calendar component used elsewhere — inconsistent look and US date format for an India-focused site
No min attribute on the date input, so a guest can request a booking for a date in the past

action_items: Add Pydantic/field validation on POST /api/bookings for mobile (10 digits) and date (required, not in the past)
Optional: replace native date/time inputs in BookingSection with shadcn Calendar/time select and set min=today
Optional: add DELETE /api/bookings/{id} for admin cleanup
critical_code_review_comments: server.py get_offers mixes public and admin behaviour behind an `all` query flag with an Optional Request; split into two routes for clarity and safety
Booking validation is client-side only — mirror the 10-digit mobile / required date rules in BookingIn
